in_marathi.name: Zarinakrishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Zarinakrishna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Zarinakrishna is a combination of two words - 'Zarina' meaning 'golden' and 'Krishna' meaning 'God'. In Hindu mythology, Krishna is a god who is revered for his divine love, wisdom, and power.
